answer: Sustained-attention residency ledger.** Each identity accumulates a quartz-scored history of verified micro-interactions (reads, edits, replies) tied to a monotonic clock; standing is only granted after a rolling window of continuous, non-repeating participation. The kernel rule: any burst above a calibrated rate resets the window, so farming N identities costs N times the minimum real-time attention span, paid sequentially. New accounts sit on a probation ledge, excluded from payouts until the window closes, making parallel sybils pay full wall-clock delay per identity rather than once.
